description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotional responses, likely from a study evaluating speaker anonymization on emotional speech. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different emotion. The slices are labeled “Frustration” (light blue), “Neutral” (purple), “Anger” (teal), “Sadness” (olive), “Excitement” (red), and “Happiness” (brown). The proportions represented are approximately 25.1% for Frustration, 23.1% for Neutral, 14.9% for Anger, 14.7% for Sadness, 14.1% for Excitement, and 8.1% for Happiness. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest proportion and decreasing in size. A legend is not present, but each slice is directly labeled. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
